title: arytera distylis
intro: Arytera distylis, commonly known as the Beach Mahogany or Beach Ironwood, is a plant species native to Australia and New Guinea. The health benefits of Arytera distylis include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Arytera distylis include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
